baseline.text: İki bahçe de ürününü verdi ve ondan hiçbir şeyi eksiltmedi. İkisinin arasından bir ırmak akıttık.

findings.text: Bahçelerin hiçbir ürünü eksiltmemesi, sahibinin sonraki yanlışını kıtlığa değil, eksiksiz nimeti yanlış yorumlamasına bağlar.
Bahçelerin ürünü eksiltmemesi, bitkisel verime ahlaki bir haksızlık etmeme eylemi yükleyen bir okuma doğurabilir.

activation_trace.role: Dual enclosure makes both gardens one complete unit of performance.
Emergent growth and output presents the yield as realized production.
Crop yield identifies the material delivered by the system.
Withholding a due right makes the negation an assertion of zero retained output.
A wide opening and release supplies the system's hydraulic input.
An interstice or traversing gap locates the flow inside the paired estate.
An earth-cutting current completes the internal circulation mechanism.

changed_reading.after: The ayah inventories a fully functioning dual production system whose output and internal water flow are both complete.
changed_reading.before: Two lush gardens produced a full crop beside a river.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The dual subject, complete yield, negated diminution, and river opened through both gardens.
baseline_models.mechanism: Two enclosed productive units operate as one audited hydraulic system: both deliver crop output, none is withheld, and an opened internal channel distributes abundant flow.

activation_trace.role: Coverage of both units establishes the outer scope of the audit.
An allotted edible share recasts produce as provision owed to a recipient.
The withholding branch turns crop shortfall into failure to discharge a due share.
The individually knowable thing drives the claim down to item-level completeness.

changed_reading.after: Each garden discharges every due unit of provision without withholding, so abundance is exact performance rather than size alone.
changed_reading.before: Neither garden suffered a crop deficit.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from both gardens to their yield and then to not one withheld thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse moves from paired totality to allotted provision to item-level non-withholding, making completeness distributive rather than merely aggregate.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment gives the gardens a hidden interior.
Dense, surging vegetation supplies the material that encloses that interior.
Forceful splitting opens what enclosure had kept latent.
The gap becomes a traversable route through the hidden interior.
Opening and widening until flow turns the route into manifest circulation.

changed_reading.after: The scene is organized as concealment opened from within, so abundance becomes perceptible through a newly released circulation.
changed_reading.before: A river runs among densely planted gardens.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: A covered garden-space is crossed by a forcefully opened river.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dense enclosure hides the productive interior; rupture creates a traversing passage and converts concealed potential into visible circulation.

activation_trace.role: Concealment lets lush visibility mask the estate's enabling source.
Boundary crossing supplies the prohibited movement of attention.
The looking eye makes attention the mechanism's operating medium.
Displayed beautification converts material completeness into attraction.
Leaving something outside vigilance names the cognitive cost of capture.

changed_reading.after: Its very completeness can be read as an engineered field of attraction that captures sight while concealing dependence.
changed_reading.before: The ayah neutrally certifies an exceptionally productive estate.

context_deltas.mechanism: The complete garden can function as a visual capture device: displayed beauty pulls the eye across a commanded boundary, while dense enclosure hides the source and contingency of what is seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gaze, displayed beauty, heedlessness, and concealed garden-space; I infer an arrow from visual completeness to attentional capture. The live alternative is that the rebuke about gaze remains independent of this estate.
structural_cues: The command not to let the eyes pass beyond the worshippers precedes the fully productive estate.
The focus ayah stacks duality, full yield, zero loss, and interior flow into a visually total scene.

activation_trace.role: Giving makes the garden's output a delivered return.
Allotted provision supplies the material form of recompense.
Negated withholding makes the return exact.
Purposive action supplies the input to the recompense sequence.
Loss and disappearance provide the directly negated failure mode.
Payment for work names the return that is not lost.
A recompense returning to its actor extends the garden's delivery model.
The final consequence supplies the temporal endpoint of the return.

changed_reading.after: The crop report becomes a miniature recompense ledger in which intended input returns as provision without loss or withholding.
changed_reading.before: The crop report establishes agricultural success.

context_deltas.mechanism: Intentional work is promised an undiminished return; the focus garden materially performs that rule by delivering every share, while the closing recompense and outcome extend the return beyond the estate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel loss-negations, payment, returning recompense, and the garden-river sequence; I infer that the focus estate materializes an exact-return rule. It can alternatively remain a literal estate contrasted with, rather than modeling, recompense.
structural_cues: 18:30 negates loss of reward; 18:33 negates diminution of produce; 18:44 closes on recompense and outcome.
The reward gardens and running rivers of 18:31 stand between the promise and the parable.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate disposition puts each productive component into a designed state.
A surrounding edge establishes the estate's outer perimeter.
The middle interval supplies a central productive zone.
Cultivation fills that middle with a growing crop.
A traversing interstice supplies the route across nested zones.
The incised flowing channel turns geometric linkage into water distribution.

changed_reading.after: The river is the connective line in a deliberately nested spatial system, not merely another luxury item.
changed_reading.before: The verse adds a river to an already rich list of garden features.

context_deltas.mechanism: Placement, perimeter, middle, and traversal form a nested cross-section: palms bound twin vineyard units, cultivation occupies their middle, and water cuts through the interior to connect the zones.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies perimeter, middle, crop, gap, and flowing channel; I infer a designed irrigation cross-section and a distributing role for the river. The river could instead be ornamental or independently flowing.
structural_cues: The sequence moves from outer enclosure to a middle crop and then to a river through the dual estate.
Repeated dual pronouns bind the perimeter and interior flow to the same two gardens.

activation_trace.role: Provision is the initial asset that can be converted into other forms of advantage.
Growing wealth shifts the crop from edible output toward accumulated capital.
Numerical rivalry turns capital into a comparative claim.
Acquired and abundant property names the intermediate asset state.
A mobilizable supporting group is the claimed social return on wealth.
A faction that returns to its head supplies the group form explicitly denied later.
Effective aid is the terminal benefit that the asset chain fails to produce.

changed_reading.after: The produce is the first node in a failed asset-conversion chain from crop to wealth to social protection.
changed_reading.before: The produce is food and evidence of fertile land.

context_deltas.mechanism: Garden output is converted from provision into growing wealth, then into numerical rivalry and expected group strength; the later absence of a returning faction or aid breaks the conversion chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision, wealth, numerical rivalry, group support, and failed aid; I infer a conversion chain from crop to social power. A live alternative is that the boast lists independent advantages without causal conversion.
structural_cues: 18:34 immediately turns fruit into a boast of more wealth and a stronger group.
18:43 later negates both supporting faction and self-rescue.

activation_trace.role: Negated withholding makes the garden a faithful delivering agent.
Entry places the owner's failure inside the very system that performs faithfully.
Positive withholding or denial reverses the focus negation onto the owner.
Supposition supplies the faulty inference from present output to permanence.
Destruction names the possibility excluded by that inference.
Indefinite duration converts observed regularity into an absolute claim.

changed_reading.after: The faithful garden becomes a foil for its owner: it withholds nothing, while he withholds recognition and mistakes performance for permanence.
changed_reading.before: The no-loss clause measures agricultural reliability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden is negated as a withholder, but its owner is immediately asserted as one who wrongs himself inside it; present reliability is then misread as proof against destruction and time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same root under opposite polarity, interior entry, supposition, destruction, and duration; I infer a contrast between faithful system and unfaithful interpreter. The focus negation can alternatively remain only an idiom for crop deficit.
structural_cues: The garden's negated wrongdoing in 18:33 is followed by the owner's self-wrongdoing in 18:35.
The owner makes his permanence claim while physically inside the garden.

activation_trace.role: Growth emerging from the gardens supplies proximate productive agency.
The opened watercourse is explicitly assigned to the enabling divine actor.
Mastery and ownership identify the ultimate level of governance.
Negated participation prevents proximate control from becoming shared ultimate agency.
Will attached to the thing places the estate's realized state under contingency.
Strength gathered like corded strands supplies the capacity denied as independent.

changed_reading.after: The ayah already distinguishes local production from enabling agency, exposing exclusive ownership as a grammatical as well as moral misreading.
changed_reading.before: The gardens and river together describe the owner's productive property.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus grammar distributes agency between gardens that yield and the divine actor who opens their water source; the later denial of partnership and independent strength blocks the owner from collapsing both levels into possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a grammatical subject shift, mastery, negated partnership, will, and strength; I infer a two-level causal map that permits creaturely production without autonomous ownership. The later formula may instead function only as prescribed speech.
structural_cues: The gardens are the grammatical subject of yielding, while the first-person divine subject opens the river.
The owner is then instructed to acknowledge willing and strength at the moment of entering his garden.

activation_trace.role: Opened release establishes accessible water as the system's live support.
A surface-cutting current gives that support a traversable location.
Water itself is the element subjected to spatial reversal.
Descent into depth reverses the focus river's opened accessibility.
Distance that forces a search marks the water as functionally unavailable.
Enclosing destruction replaces the focus system's sustaining enclosure.
Mature fruit is the output captured by the failure.
Collapse supplies the terminal state of the once complete system.
The vine-support structure identifies what physically falls with the output.

changed_reading.after: The river is a reversible dependency: abundance lasts only while water remains opened, correctly located, and reachable.
changed_reading.before: The river is a stable sign that abundance has arrived.

context_deltas.mechanism: Accessible internal flow can be vertically displaced beyond reach; once the water relation changes, mature output is enclosed by loss and its supporting cultivated structure collapses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies accessible flow, water descent, failed retrieval, fruit loss, and structural collapse; I infer that the river is a necessary support whose relocation breaks production. A direct sky strike could destroy the estate without water loss mediating the result.
structural_cues: 18:40-41 present surface strike and water descent as alternative routes to failure.
18:42 follows those alternatives with fruit encompassed and cultivation collapsed on its supports.

remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrow from river to yield is inferred because the focus reports both but does not explicitly state irrigation causation.
The ethical allocation sense of the no-diminution clause can coexist with the ordinary agronomic sense of no crop deficit.
The split-root totality and dawn-light readings are branch-backed overlays and should not replace the dominant produce and river senses.
strongest_changes: The garden's negated withholding reverses onto the self-wronging owner, separating faithful output from failed recognition.
The focus grammar distributes proximate production and enabling agency before the owner claims autonomous possession.
Water descent and structural collapse turn the river from a luxury sign into a reversible dependency.
Produce enters a conversion chain from provision to wealth to social support, whose promised aid ultimately fails.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah behaves like a compact systems audit: dual scope, delivered output, zero withholding, and internal flow later become ethical, causal, social, and failure-state variables without losing their focus anchors.

activation_trace.role: Dual enclosure totalizes the two productive units.
The split mapped branch of whole-part inclusion inserts a second scale of totality at the yield.
The identifiable item closes the sequence by denying even one exception.

changed_reading.after: A triple totalization saturates the clause at estate, output, and item scales: both, whole, not one thing.
changed_reading.before: The verse says the two gardens lost none of their produce.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This uses the packet's form-distant split mapping of the yield root, so it is surprising but resolvable and reinforced by two independent focus anchors; downstream prose should present it as a rhetorical totality overlay, not as the lexical gloss of produce.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves through both units, whole output, and not one identifiable thing.

activation_trace.role: Night's covering supplies the dark enclosure from which exposure begins.
Dawn breaking from night converts hydraulic rupture into a light-opening overlay.
The traversing gap gives the opening a route through the concealed interior.
Daylight opening supplies the luminous counterpart to the literal current.
The first morning marker begins the later sequence of visible reversal.
The second morning marker applies exposure to the missing water.
The third morning marker reveals the estate's completed ruin.

changed_reading.after: The opening also resembles daylight breaking through concealment, while the later mornings expose the same estate in reversal.
changed_reading.before: Water is opened through the garden interior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus still denotes a real river, but dawn, daylight, concealment, and repeated morning branches create a valid cross-domain overlay; downstream prose should qualify this as an imagistic exposure reading, not replace the hydraulic sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Concealed garden-space, a forceful opening, a passage through it, and a river whose root also carries daylight.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The gardens’ full performance removes material excuse.** `ش ي ء` B001’s “knowable thing” variant is under total negation: no item of yield is withheld. Later the record omits neither small nor great and wrongs no one (18:49). I infer a material-accounting analogy: complete provision makes the owner’s later self-wronging attributable to interpretation, not shortage. The landscape is a faithful producer before he becomes an unfaithful reader.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:49’s exhaustive record made the gardens’ complete yield look like an anticipatory material account.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Non-withholding as the garden’s moral action.** `ظ ل م/B008` supplies prevention and withholding, which the negation `لَمْ تَظْلِم` attaches to fruit production. Two ayat later the owner enters as `ظَالِمٌ لِنَفْسِهِ` (18:35); between them he converts yielded fruit into a boast of personal abundance (18:34). I infer that the garden’s full transfer of its due becomes a standard against which its owner fails: the system yields, but he withholds acknowledgment of its source. The fixed phrase reads as just distribution, not only lack of agricultural deficiency.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 18:35 reused `ظ ل م` for the owner’s self-relation, turning the garden’s non-withholding into an unexpectedly moral comparison.

words.gloss_range: both of a feminine pair, with distributive totality rather than a loose collective sense
words.prose: {{ar:كِلْتَا}} ({{tr:kiltā}}) opens the ayah by placing the whole two-garden set under audit before any action appears. The form makes both gardens individually included, while the following feminine singular verbs treat the pair as one grammatical unit for yield and non-loss. Its rare feminine dual shape also keeps the verse's frame tight: measured dual completeness at the start, one sustaining river at the end, with the paired-care field reversing from restrained harsh flow in 17:23 to granted water flow in 18:33.
words.root_gloss_range: dual-totality and bounded-coverage pressure; derivational links to guarding or totality remain secondary to the local quantifier function

topics.headline: dual totality audit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah evaluates both gardens, not merely an estate taken as a collective whole.
topics.reason: The QAC grammar and attachment evidence make the quantified pair the shared subject of the yield and non-diminution clauses.

topics.headline: singular agreement for a pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the grammar alternating between pairhood and singular treatment without losing the two-garden referent.
topics.reason: The local predicates and suffixes support a singular grammatical unit while the referent remains a dual pair.

topics.headline: rare dual frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a rare dual form links this garden scene to paired-care and flow contrasts, especially the opposite n-h-r valences in 17:23 and 18:33.
topics.reason: The rarity and cross-reference pressure survive, but derivational or inter-ayah links cannot override the local quantifier grammar.

words.gloss_range: the two known gardens, definite and genitive under the preceding quantifier
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ}} ({{tr:al-jannatayni}}) names the already known pair as the genitive complement of the opening quantifier. The dual and definiteness keep the scene from becoming generic garden imagery: these are the two bounded gardens whose yield, non-loss, and interior river will be tested. The concealment field of the root remains useful because the ayah turns enclosed productivity into visible output and a revealed inner channel, while the familiar garden-river field is localized into this one parable estate with a single unnamed river.
words.root_gloss_range: enclosed or concealed garden space; broader concealment derivatives are secondary images, not alternate local senses

topics.headline: known bounded pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah resumes and evaluates a specific two-garden pair from 18:32.
topics.reason: Definiteness, dual marking, and construct government all support a known bounded pair under the opening quantifier.

topics.headline: productive enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that enclosure is not decorative; the gardens are concealed productive spaces whose inner resources become visible as yield and river.
topics.reason: The local sense is garden, so wider concealment derivatives are admitted only as controlled imagery tied to yield and inner route.

topics.headline: garden-river formula localized
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a familiar garden-river field narrowed into one parable estate with two known gardens and one unnamed river.
topics.reason: The co-occurrence evidence is compatible with the local grammar because the ayah keeps the referent definite and narratively specific.

words.gloss_range: completed Form IV delivery of produce by the garden subject
words.prose: {{ar:ءَاتَتْ}} ({{tr:ātat}}) makes the gardens' yield a completed delivered fact. Its feminine singular ending ties the verb to the quantified garden pair, while Form IV makes the produce arrive as an output rather than a vague state of fertility. The verb also prepares the ayah's agency shift: the gardens deliver yield, the later river-opening verb reveals divine action behind the watercourse, and the same giving thread moves toward possible divine replacement in 18:40. The exact garden-yield phrase also recalls 2:265, so this is a recognizable productivity formula made local.
words.root_gloss_range: coming, bringing, giving, causing to arrive; local Form IV selects delivered yield

topics.headline: completed garden delivery
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the gardens are credited with delivered yield, not merely described as fertile scenery.
topics.reason: The perfect Form IV verb takes the produce as its direct object and agrees with the quantified garden subject.

topics.headline: feminine agreement link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb form itself keeps the non-human dual pair inside a singular feminine predicate frame.
topics.reason: The feminine marker is locally licensed by the garden subject; variant evidence is useful only as contrast.

topics.headline: agency and giving thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices provision moving from garden delivery to divine giving or replacement elsewhere in the parable unit.
topics.reason: The root recurrences and local clause sequence support an agency contrast without making the garden an owner-independent giver.

topics.headline: productive-garden formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase shape as part of a Quranic garden-yield formula, including the parallel in 2:265.
topics.reason: The phrase relation is concrete and does not conflict with the local direct-object frame.

words.gloss_range: the garden's own consumable yield or produce, gathered as one measurable output
words.prose: {{ar:أُكُلَهَا}} ({{tr:ukulahā}}) is the delivered object, the garden's own consumable output rather than scenery. The suffix binds the yield to the garden subject, while the singular construct gathers the output into one measurable total. That total then becomes the domain from which the following partitive-plus-thing phrase denies any subtraction; the wider eating root lets erosion and devouring press against that denial without replacing the local sense of usable produce. The perfect yield also sits in a wider crop field, answering the garden-yield formula of 2:265 and contrasting bitter produce in 34:16, while accepted recitation can lighten the word's internal weight without changing its object role.
words.root_gloss_range: eating, consumption, consumable produce, and erosion; local noun selects usable yield

topics.headline: garden-bound yield object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that abundance is measured by each garden's own usable output.
topics.reason: The noun is the direct object of the delivery verb and carries a possessive suffix tied to the garden referent.

topics.headline: consumable output range

topics.headline: yield formula and contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that perfect yield here belongs to a broader garden-yield field, including the bitter-produce contrast in 34:16 and the crop formula in 2:265.
topics.reason: The intertext rows provide concrete parallels and contrasts while the local clause remains a specific garden-output statement.

topics.headline: recitation weight at the yield word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accepted recitation can alter the word's weight while preserving its role as the produce object.
topics.reason: The qiraat point is valid but affects cadence more than lexical interpretation.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector joining the positive yield clause to the negated non-loss clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the negative clause attached to the positive yield statement. The ayah does not first praise the gardens and then add an unrelated denial; it defines completeness through two linked sides: the gardens gave their yield and did not diminish anything from it. This first connector stays inside garden agency, unlike the later connector that pivots into the divine river-opening clause.

topics.headline: affirmation joined to negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that yield and non-loss form one completeness construction.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the coordinated negated predicate under the same garden subject.

topics.headline: first connector contrasted with second
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two connector jobs in the ayah: this one stays inside garden agency, while the later one pivots to divine agency.
topics.reason: The contrast is licensed by the clause architecture and supported by the local connector sequence.

words.gloss_range: past negation governing the following imperfect as a completed denial of loss
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) converts the following imperfect into a governed past negation. It pivots the reader from the fact of delivered yield to a deficit audit: no act of diminution occurred, and the scope stays inside the garden-yield clause rather than reaching the later river clause.

topics.headline: past negation governance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that non-diminution is stated as an accomplished fact, not as ongoing uncertainty.
topics.reason: The particle governs the imperfect verb and supplies past negative force.

topics.headline: deficit audit pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause shifting from production to the question of whether any due output was withheld.
topics.reason: The particle begins the negated predicate that completes the productivity frame.

words.gloss_range: did not wrong, diminish, or withhold from the yield within a negated jussive frame
words.prose: {{ar:تَظْلِمْ}} ({{tr:taẓlim}}) makes the absence of loss morally charged. With the following partitive source and thing-word, the verb says that no part or degree of the yield was diminished, while the root keeps the idea of wrong placement in view. This matters for the parable because the garden does no wrong here, but the owner will be called wronging in 18:35. The darkness side of the root is also locally narrowed into a reveal-not-conceal movement: nothing is darkened or withheld before the river is burst open through the interior.
words.root_gloss_range: wronging, putting out of place, diminution, and darkness; local grammar selects non-diminution with moral coloring

topics.headline: zero-loss grammar
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb is completed by source and extent language, making the no-loss claim measurable.
topics.reason: The verb is governed by negation and takes the following partitive phrase and accusative extent/object.

topics.headline: moral diminution range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a quantitative shortfall is framed as a kind of wronging, not merely bad crop performance.
topics.reason: The local construction selects non-diminution, while the root's moral range remains active as evaluative force.

topics.headline: just garden, wronging owner

topics.headline: darkness to disclosure

topics.reason: Darkness imagery is secondary to the local non-diminution sense but coheres with the immediately following disclosure verb.

words.gloss_range: from it, of it, or out of it, preserving the source/partitive domain of the denied loss
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْهُ}} ({{tr:minhu}}) supplies the source domain before the smallest possible object is named. The phrase says where the zero applies: no subtraction from the yield domain. Its masculine suffix keeps a live ambiguity with the earlier feminine suffix on the produce word, so translation should not flatten the reference too quickly: it may point to the produce itself or to an implied yield total.

topics.headline: partitive source domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the no-loss claim is anchored to a source: the yield domain from which nothing is taken.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is attached to the negated verb and establishes the source of any possible diminution.

topics.headline: live pronoun ambiguity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pronoun shift from feminine garden-bound yield to a masculine source, leaving produce or yield-total both possible.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence explicitly marks the suffix reference as ambiguous and instructs preservation of that ambiguity.

words.gloss_range: anything, a single countable thing, or a degree specification under negation
words.prose: {{ar:شَيْـًۭٔا}} ({{tr:shayʾan}}) closes the negated clause by reducing possible loss to the smallest countable unit. As an indefinite accusative under the negation particle, it can function as object or specification, but either way the effect is total: not one thing, not one measurable degree, was missing from the yield. The broad thing-word brings a justice-style no-wronging-in-anything formula into the garden audit, and the final hamza makes the zero-loss clause land with a sharp stop before the river clause begins.
words.root_gloss_range: thinghood, countability, and possible existence; local indefinite accusative gives maximal zero scope

topics.reason: The hamza-bearing final form is a valid recitational payoff tied to clause position.

words.gloss_range: resumptive connector opening a new divine-subject clause
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before the river-opening verb is a pivot, not another same-subject link. It keeps the description continuous while opening a new clause whose subject is the divine We. The ayah therefore moves from the gardens' completed output to the hidden infrastructure God releases through them, making the two connector frame audible: first the yield audit is completed, then divine infrastructure is disclosed.

topics.headline: resumptive divine pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the agency shift from garden predicates to divine intervention.
topics.reason: The following verb carries first-person plural subject marking, so the connector begins a new subject domain.

topics.headline: two connector frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a two-stage structure: one connector completes the yield audit, the second reveals divine infrastructure.
topics.reason: The two local connectors have different clause relations, and the second reconnects the divine construction arc from 18:32.

words.gloss_range: We caused to burst forth, with intensive causative force directed to the river object
words.prose: {{ar:فَجَّرْنَا}} ({{tr:fajjarnā}}) is the ayah's strongest pivot: the subject changes to divine We, and Form II makes the river a forcefully released object. The verb opens the hidden middle of the gardens, so the final abundance is not merely crop success but disclosed infrastructure. Its root imagery can touch dawn, water, and rupture, yet the local object keeps the active sense on divine water-release, not moral transgression. The same divine release verb can irrigate here and destroy in 54:12, while 17:91 turns a burst-river garden into a demanded sign-shape; the doubled consonant and Form I variant contrast make the force of the local Form II audible.
words.root_gloss_range: bursting, cleaving, water release, dawn-splitting, and boundary-breaking; local Form II selects divine release of water

topics.reason: The verb is perfect first-person plural Form II and governs the river object.

words.gloss_range: through their midst, through the interval belonging to both gardens
words.prose: {{ar:خِلَٰلَهُمَا}} ({{tr:khilālahumā}}) makes the river's route inseparable from the river itself. The adverb places the divine bursting through the shared interval of the two gardens, and the dual suffix refuses a one-garden interior reading. Its root field gives the positive image: a gap or between-space becomes a connective watercourse. The garden-with-river-through-the-midst motif from 17:91 is specialized here by the dual suffix, and the uncommon route-form concentrates attention on interior passage as the final clause's key spatial relation.
words.root_gloss_range: gap, interval, penetration, inner access, and through-the-midst relation; local form selects spatial route

words.gloss_range: a specific but unnamed river, singular and indefinite as the object of divine bursting
words.prose: {{ar:نَهَرًۭا}} ({{tr:naharan}}) resolves the final divine clause as its object: what God burst through the gardens is one river serving two gardens. The singular indefinite form makes it a particular unnamed channel, not the usual plural definite garden-rivers formula, and its final position lets the ayah land on continuing flow after the zero-loss audit. The root's abundance and visibility pressures fit the scene, while rebuke remains a contrastive echo with 17:23 rather than the local sense; the nearby reward-garden river backdrop in 18:31 and the next movement's wealth statement in 18:34 keep this final flow connected beyond the verse boundary.
words.root_gloss_range: river flow, copious directed water, daylight visibility, and rebuke as a secondary contrast; local noun selects river
